headline: Daedream Dream Chaser
title: Daedream | Dark Bullets Follow Your Fight | Palworld Guide
video_script: Daedream fights beside you without being summoned. Its partner skill, Dream Chaser, keeps it near the player while in your party, and it shoots Dark magic bullets at hostile enemies. These bullets will not take a target below one health. At base it works Handiwork, Gathering and Transporting, all at level one. Do you take Daedream along? Comment below!
description: Daedream in Palworld 1.0: Dream Chaser fires Dark bullets that never drop a target under one health.
